study: Read-only reproduction of saved AI4I risk-model predictions and sample-weighted quantile calibration
dataset_source: UCI Machine Learning Repository, DOI 10.24432/C5HS5C, AI4I 2020 synthetic dataset
holdout_policy: train_test_split(test_size=0.20, random_state=42, stratify=Machine failure); no model refitting
checks: Confusion matrix agrees with historical saved matrix
All 8 occupied quantile bin count totals sum to 2,000
Manual quantile bins match sklearn.calibration.calibration_curve outputs
Historical 0.007 is the rounded unweighted mean gap, not a weighted ECE
limits: Model loaded from a version-different scikit-learn (1.9.0 saved, 1.8.0 reproduced), and raised cross-version warnings; exact selected-split ROC-AUC, PR-AUC and confusion matrix matched existing output, but cross-version compatibility is not guaranteed.
Weighted ECE is a descriptive metric on previously selected/reused in-sample historical holdout; it does not establish independent prospective calibration or improve scoring rankings.
Not a new fit, untouched external evaluation, industrial operating measurement, or production deployment claim.
Raw predictions and licensed input rows are not redistributed; artifact contains aggregate diagnostics only.
